m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Did you appease the Ghosts? What? No ghosts... just Marleybonians? They're crying because they got stuck trying to discover Polaris?
But it's already been discovered. No matter. The poor devils must be in rough shape. Of course I'll help. Anything to shut them up.
I've an idea! A trade ship delivered a huge shipment of Marleymite a while back but no self-respecting Pingouin would ever touch the stuff.
It's been sitting in the Customs Storage for months! Surely they won't mind if you took a Crate for the hungry Explorers.
When I want your opinion I'll ask for it, Barrow! I've a foolproof plan to help us all, and I don't need you distracting our new friend.
Now, Savage. My men and I require food. Could you or someone from your little tribe or camp or whatnot procure us something edible?
Anything will do. We're not picky. Just nothing too heavy. The men have a long day of ice chipping ahead of them. Thank you!
Benevolent Savage, you've returned! And what is that mouthwatering aroma? Is that... Marleymite? Rejoice, men! We're saved!
Compose yourself, Crozier! Don't yell in front of the native. You'll scare it off!
Quiet, the both of you! It's like you want me to write you up for insubordination!
Good Savage, you have saved our lives and more importantly, our Expedition. I believe I promised you a reward.
For your generosity, I will personally name a small and insignificant part of Polaris after you once I've discovered it. You are welcome.
Now that we'll soon have warmer clothing, the last little thing our valiant expedition requires to get back on track is food.
Now now, Savage. Standing here isn't going to put food in my... er... our bellies. Go ask to your tribe about getting us some food!
